      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies node RPC handling in src/rpc/output_script.cpp and src/rpc/descriptor_util.cpp by adding a verbose parameter to getdescriptorinfo to return descriptor policy trees.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.45,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Extending getdescriptorinfo eliminates the need for external tools to parse descriptor strings manually to determine policy trees. This addresses a clear gap for downstream callers inspecting descriptors, though it is reasonably deferrable as a general RPC enhancement."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",

    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Adds src/wallet/descriptor_analyzer.cpp and the analyzedescriptor wallet RPC to correlate descriptor keys with loaded wallets.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.7,
      "reason_tag": "fund safety",
      "rationale": "Allows multisig participants to verify descriptors before importing them to prevent fund-safety pitfalls such as repeated keys lowering effective spending thresholds. It provides durable value for multisig safety and unblocks higher-level multisig setup tooling."
